summary: Indirect byte reader: reads the target pointer stored at this+0x0, then returns the byte at offset 20 (0x14) of the pointed-to object. A thiscall helper exposing a single flag/status byte from a referenced structure; no guards, no other side effects.

operations.description: Read the target pointer stored at this+0x0; the returned byte lives in the object it points to.
Return *(BYTE*)(*(DWORD*)this + 20), the byte at offset 20 (0x14) of the dereferenced object.

unresolved: The identity and semantics of the target structure behind field obj+0x14 are unknown; existing analysis calls it a flag/status byte but that is unverified.
Whether this+0x0 points at a distinct object or into a larger containing structure is not established.
